intent: An editable table: people click a cell to add or change its content, like rule conditions, line items, or mappings. It validates cells, can total the valid rows, and stacks below 30rem.
useWhen: People build or change rows in place: rule conditions, price tiers, field mappings, line items
Short editable lists where a form per row would be slow
doNotUseWhen: Short read-only text rows — use Table
Searchable, filterable datasets people read and select — use DataTable
A form of Fields and Inputs per row

columns.note: type defaults to text. select needs options. date is kit DatePicker; value is YYYY-MM-DD. number and money are end-aligned with tabular figures and hold decimal strings ("18", "39.00"); money shows them in currency (default USD). compute makes a derived, read-only column such as Amount = Qty × Unit price; it is not a formula editor. validate returns a short fix ("enter 1 or more") or undefined. Do not add type formula: there is no FormulaEditor; a computed column is the only derived value.

rows.note: Controlled rows, one string per column key. Save with onRowsChange. Do not wrap the grid in Form.

defaultRows.note: Starting rows when rows is not controlled.

onRowsChange.note: (rows: DataGridRow[]) => void. Runs when a cell is saved and when rows are added or removed.

label.note: Accessible name for the table, and each cell, like Value, row 2.

size.note: Passed to HeaderCell. Edit controls are size sm.

canAddRows.note: Add row button under the grid. Not primary. New row starts empty; first cell opens for editing (when stacked, the row opens).

canRemoveRows.note: Remove control at the end of each row. Named in a kit Tooltip.

emptyLabel.note: Shown in one td with colSpan when there are no rows.

rowNumbers.note: A # column with each row's number.

stickyFirstColumn.note: The # column (if shown) and the first data column stay in place while the grid scrolls sideways.

totals.note: (validRows) => { label, value, emphasis?, narrowLabel? }[]. Footer lines worked out from rows with no invalid cell, e.g. Subtotal, VAT 20%, Total. Values are pre-formatted. The emphasised line is the grand total and the only one shown when the grid stacks, with narrowLabel ("Total incl. VAT").

errorSummary.note: A status line above the grid: "1 line needs a fix" / "3 lines need a fix". Empty when every row is valid.

requirements: Native table named by label, with kit HeaderCell headers and th scope=col
Each idle text cell is a button named by its column and row with its value, like Value, row 2: 100
Select and date columns always show the kit Select or DatePicker in the cell so the grid does not shift when the value changes
Enter or click on a text cell opens a kit Input named the same way, inset in the cell, and focus moves into it
Enter saves and Escape cancels; focus goes back to the cell. Tab moves to the next cell
Remove row buttons are named Remove row 2 and show that in a Tooltip
A date cell editor is a kit DatePicker named by its column and row, like Start date, row 2
Empty state is one td with colSpan and emptyLabel
Number and money cells are end-aligned with tabular figures
A computed cell is plain read-only text, not a button; on a row with an invalid cell it shows an em dash

An invalid cell gets a danger ring and an icon on that cell only, aria-invalid, and aria-describedby pointing at its message ("Qty, row 3: enter 1 or more · left out of the total") in the row under it
Rows with an invalid cell are left out of totals; errorSummary is a role status line
Totals sit in tfoot with th scope=row labels
Below 30rem of grid width the grid stacks: each row is a button with aria-expanded that opens labelled fields; an invalid row starts open with its message under the field
Wider than that but still narrow, the table keeps column min-width and scrolls horizontally; the scroller is a focusable region

doNot: Do not invent EditableCell, GridRow, or a table of loose Inputs. Pass columns with a type.
Do not wrap the grid in Form. Save the rows from onRowsChange.
Search, filters, column settings, sort, or bulk selection — use DataTable
Short read-only text rows — use Table
Do not use Cell for editable body cells — Cell is display content for DataTable
Do not add type formula. A computed column (compute) is allowed; there is no FormulaEditor. Stop and ask for anything more.
Do not add Density or expandable row detail. Rows open only when the grid stacks below 30rem, to edit that row
Do not make Add row a primary Button
Do not colour a whole row for one invalid cell; mark the cell
snippet:
<DataGrid
  label="Conditions"
  columns={[
    { key: "field", header: "Field" },
    { key: "condition", header: "Condition", type: "select", options: conditions, width: "12rem" },
    { key: "value", header: "Value" },
  ]}
  rows={rules}
  onRowsChange={setRules}
  canAddRows
  canRemoveRows
/>

<DataGrid
  label="Invoice INV-1887 lines"
  rowNumbers
  canAddRows
  canRemoveRows
  errorSummary
  columns={[
    { key: "description", header: "Description" },
    { key: "qty", header: "Qty", type: "number", width: "6rem", validate: (v) => (Number(v) >= 1 ? undefined : "enter 1 or more") },
    { key: "unit", header: "Unit price", type: "money", width: "8rem" },
    { key: "tax", header: "Tax", type: "select", options: taxRates, width: "10rem" },
    { key: "amount", header: "Amount", type: "money", width: "8rem", compute: (row) => (Number(row.qty) * Number(row.unit)).toFixed(2) },
  ]}
  rows={lines}
  onRowsChange={setLines}
  totals={(valid) => invoiceTotals(valid)}
/>
